# 2240 Speed Shop

> 2240 Speed Shop is a customs-and-classics automotive shop in Edmonton, Alberta, owned by Terry Harmider. The shop does full classic car restorations, restomods and hot rods, LS and diesel engine swaps and builds, carburetor and ignition performance work, rust repair, metal fabrication and paint, and period-correct interiors and classic mechanical service. Address: 2009 91 Ave NW, Edmonton, AB T6P 1L1, Canada. Phone: 780-999-6450. Email: 2240speedshop@gmail.com. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00. Serving Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Leduc, Nisku, Spruce Grove, and Fort Saskatchewan.

The shop sits on the Sherwood Park boundary in east Edmonton. Work is quoted on scope and real hours rather than flat-rate guesses, and builds are specified for Alberta conditions — engines that start at −30 °C, bodywork that accounts for calcium-chloride road brine, and finishes that survive winter storage.

## Services

- [Classic Car Restoration](https://2240speedshop.com/services/classic-car-restoration/): frame-off and rolling restorations of classic cars and trucks, stripped to bare metal and rebuilt to one standard
- [Restomods & Hot Rods](https://2240speedshop.com/services/restomods-custom-builds/): period looks with modern running gear — disc brake conversions, modern suspension and drivetrain under original sheet metal
- [Engine Swaps & Builds](https://2240speedshop.com/services/engine-swaps-builds/): LS and diesel conversions, engine builds, mounts, wiring, cooling and driveline, specified to start and run in Alberta cold
- [Performance & Tuning](https://2240speedshop.com/services/classic-performance-tuning/): carburetor rebuilds and tuning, points-to-electronic ignition upgrades, exhaust and bolt-on performance for classics and muscle
- [Body, Paint & Metalwork](https://2240speedshop.com/services/body-paint-metalwork/): rust repair, patch panels, floor pans, fabrication and paint on Alberta cars
- [Interiors & Classic Service](https://2240speedshop.com/services/classic-interiors-service/): period-correct leather, wood trim and vintage fabrics, plus brakes, ignition and classic mechanical service

## Guides — the facts worth quoting

- [Restoration Costs in Canada](https://2240speedshop.com/guides/costs/): CAD planning ranges by scope — roughly $4,000–$15,000 for a mechanical refresh, $15,000–$60,000 for a rolling restoration, $60,000–$120,000 for a driver-quality frame-off, $120,000–$250,000+ for show quality, and $80,000+ for a restomod. A full frame-off is commonly a 1,000-plus hour job, so labour sets the number, not parts.
- [Modified Vehicle Laws in Alberta](https://2240speedshop.com/guides/alberta-laws/): the general framework on exhaust noise, window tint, lift height, out-of-province inspections, salvage-to-rebuilt status, antique plates, and declaring modifications to an insurer in Alberta's private insurance market. Written non-authoritatively — readers are directed to Alberta Transportation, a registry agent, or their insurer to confirm.
- [Winter Storage & Cold-Weather Survival](https://2240speedshop.com/guides/winter/): storage prep, fuel stabiliser and ethanol, battery tenders, rodent-proofing, moisture control, block and pan heaters, cold-start behaviour on carburetted engines, and the spring wake-up checklist for an Alberta winter.
- [All Guides](https://2240speedshop.com/guides/): the guide library, with links to published articles and upcoming topics marked as planned

- [St. Albert](https://2240speedshop.com/edmonton/st-albert/): about 30 minutes up the Henday
- [Leduc & Nisku](https://2240speedshop.com/edmonton/leduc-nisku/): passenger classics and customs, not only heavy-truck work
- [Spruce Grove](https://2240speedshop.com/edmonton/spruce-grove/): west-end builds welcome

## Journal

The Shop Journal (https://2240speedshop.com/blog/) is the shop's editorial layer — long-form articles written on the shop floor, with verified sources and CAD figures published as labelled typical ranges, never quotes. 40 articles live:

- [What Is a Restomod? The Definitive Guide — With Real Builds from an Edmonton Shop](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/what-is-a-restomod/): What a restomod actually is, how it differs from a restoration, what one typically costs in CAD, and what the market says about value — explained from the floor of an Edmonton customs shop.
- [What a Classic Car Restoration Costs in Canada, Stage by Stage](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-restoration-cost-canada/): Hedged Canadian-dollar ranges for every stage of a classic restoration — teardown, metal, paint, drivetrain, assembly — plus the Alberta rules that protect your budget.
- [Rust Repair on a Classic: Patch Panels, Full Panels, and Honest CAD Numbers](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/rust-repair-cost-canada/): What rust repair really costs on a classic in Canada — patch panels, full panels, and hand fabrication — and why honest estimates move once the paint comes off.
- [What a Proper Paint Job Costs in Canada — and Why the Range Is So Wide](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-paint-job-cost-canada/): Why paint quotes run from $3,000 to past $30,000 CAD — prep depth, single-stage versus base/clear, jambs, and how to tell which paint job you are actually being quoted.
- [Frame-Off or Rolling Restoration: Which One Your Car Actually Needs](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/frame-off-vs-rolling-restoration/): The structure decides — what a frame-off actually buys, when a rolling restoration is the smarter spend, and the rot and end-use markers that make the call.
- [How to Put a Classic Car Away for an Alberta Winter](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-winter-storage-alberta/): The October put-away procedure — fuel, oil, battery, tires, and mice — that gets a classic through five months of Alberta winter and starts clean in April.
- [Collector Car Insurance in Alberta: What It Covers, What It Costs, Who Qualifies](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/collector-car-insurance-alberta/): How agreed-value collector policies differ from regular Alberta auto insurance — who qualifies, what storage and use rules apply, and what coverage typically costs.
- [Buying Your First Classic Car in Alberta: A Shop Foreman's Checklist](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/buying-your-first-classic-car/): Where rust actually matters, how to run an Alberta lien search, what AMVIC covers, and the checks that keep a first classic from becoming a $30,000 lesson.
- [Can You Daily-Drive a Classic in Alberta? An Honest Answer](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/daily-driving-a-classic-in-alberta/): The honest answer on daily driving a classic in Alberta: what road chloride does, what collector policies allow, and which upgrades make shoulder seasons sane.
- [Block Heaters, Battery Tenders, and Cold Starts: Running a Classic Through an Alberta Cold Snap](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/do-classics-need-block-heaters/): Whether a vintage engine needs a block heater, which type fits old iron, and how to cold-start a carbureted classic at minus twenty — from an Edmonton shop floor.
- [Hail Season and the Classic Car: Protection, Repair, and Insurance in Alberta](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/hail-and-classic-cars-alberta/): Where Alberta's hail corridor runs, how to shelter a classic, whether paintless dent repair survives old paint, and how an agreed-value hail claim plays out.
- [Waking a Classic After Winter: The Spring Start-Up Checklist](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-spring-startup-checklist/): Every check before the first start after winter storage — nests, fluids, battery, tires, fuel, and brakes, in the order a working Edmonton shop does them.
- [Patina: Keep It, Seal It, or Paint Over It?](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/patina-keep-it-or-paint-it/): When original paint adds value, how clear-over-patina really holds up, and the exact line where truck character ends and structural rust begins — from an Edmonton shop.
- [When No One Makes the Panel: Custom Metal Fabrication for Classics](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/metal-fabrication-no-repro-panels/): No reproduction panels for your classic? How a shop hand-forms new steel over bucks, splices donor metal, and what that costs in CAD versus waiting for parts.
- [Media Blasting, Chemical Stripping, or Sanding: Taking a Classic to Bare Metal](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/stripping-paint-classic-car/): Which stripping method is safe for which panel — where blasting heat warps skins, why soda residue peels primer, and when chemical stripper earns its mess.
- [Alberta Antique Plates: The 25-Year Rule, the Restrictions, and Whether They Are Worth It](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/antique-plates-alberta/): What Alberta antique vehicle registration allows and forbids, the one-time fee, year-of-manufacture plates, and how the plate squares with collector insurance.
- [Salvage, Rebuilt, Non-Repairable: What Alberta Vehicle Status Means for a Project Car](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/salvage-rebuilt-status-alberta/): What each Alberta status stamp means for a project car — which ones can legally drive again, what the rebuilt inspection takes, and how a brand hits value.
- [Buying a Classic With No Registration: How Alberta Handles a Bill-of-Sale Car](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/registering-classic-no-title-alberta/): What an Alberta registry actually needs to plate a classic sold on a bill of sale alone — and the lien, VIN, and inspection problems that kill a farm-find deal.
- [Importing a Classic From the US Into Alberta: Duty, GST, and the 15-Year Rule](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/importing-classic-car-from-us/): The full border math on a US classic — the 15-year RIV exemption, the 25-year duty-free line, GST at the booth, Form 1, and the Alberta inspection that gets you plates.
- [What a Classic Car Pre-Purchase Inspection Actually Covers](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-pre-purchase-inspection/): What a shop checks in a pre-purchase inspection that a driveway walk-around cannot — frame rot, filler over rust, matching numbers — and what it costs in Alberta.
- [When Your Classic Needs an Appraisal — and What One Costs in Alberta](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-appraisal-alberta/): The four moments a classic actually needs a written appraisal in Alberta — agreed-value insurance, sale, estate — what the appraiser checks, and honest CAD fee ranges.
- [Selling a Classic in Canada: Pricing It, Proving It, and Picking the Venue](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/selling-a-classic-car-canada/): How to put a defensible price on a classic, which paperwork actually adds money, and whether auction, consignment, or a private sale nets more in Alberta.
- [The Alberta Show Circuit: A Season Planner From May Long to September](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/alberta-show-and-shine-season/): Which Alberta shows are worth the fuel, how to plan the calendar around three anchor weekends, and how to finish September without burning out car or family.
- [LS Swap Cost in Canada: The Real All-In Number (and the Alberta Paperwork Nobody Mentions)](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/ls-swap-cost-canada/): What an LS swap really costs in Canada — junkyard 5.3 versus crate paths in CAD, the harness and cooling money nobody budgets, and the Alberta insurance paperwork.
- [Are Exhaust Mods Legal in Alberta? Noise Laws, Edmonton's $1,000 Fine, and How Not to Get Ticketed](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/alberta-exhaust-noise-laws/): Exhaust mods are legal in Alberta with a working muffler, inside the noise rules. The equipment law, Edmonton's $1,000 fine, the noise-camera pilot, and how to pass.
- [Barn Find First Steps: Don't Start It! How to Revive a Car That Sat for Years](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/barn-find-first-steps/): Why you never turn the key on a car that sat for years, and the five-step protocol that wakes one up safely — free the engine, replace the fluids, sort the fuel, then first start. From an Edmonton shop.
- [The C10 & Square-Body Buyer's-and-Builder's Guide, Alberta Edition](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/c10-square-body-alberta-guide/): Which C10 generation to buy, where square-body Chevys rust first, what prairie trucks are actually worth, and how to source one in Alberta — from an Edmonton shop.
- [How Long Does a Classic Car Restoration Take? Stage-by-Stage, From the Shop Floor](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-restoration-timeline/): How long a classic car restoration really takes — honest hour and calendar ranges by stage, why schedules slip, and why sorting cannot be skipped. From an Edmonton shop.
- [Engine Rebuild & Performance Build Costs in Canada (2026): From Stock Refresh to Full Build](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/engine-rebuild-cost-canada/): What a stock rebuild, a performance build, and a crate engine typically cost in CAD, what Alberta machine shops charge, and where budgets actually blow up.
- [8 Signs Your Classic's Carburetor Needs a Rebuild, Not Just an Adjustment](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/carburetor-rebuild-signs/): The one-line rule that separates a carb that needs tuning from one that needs a rebuild, plus the eight symptoms that prove it — from the floor of an Edmonton shop.
- [Out-of-Province Vehicle Inspection in Edmonton: 2026 Cost, What's Checked, and the Modified-Car Trap](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/out-of-province-inspection-edmonton/): What an Alberta out-of-province inspection covers, typical 2026 Edmonton costs, the 10-day repair window, and why lifted or modified vehicles never skip it.
- [Road to Radium: The Columbia Valley Classics Show & Shine, From a Shop That Makes the Trip](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/road-to-radium-show-and-shine/): The Columbia Valley Classics Show & Shine returns to Radium Hot Springs September 18–19, 2026 — over 1,000 classics, one mountain village, and a drive we make most years.
- [Can You Stop a Classic with Drums in 2026 Traffic? Disc Conversion Costs in Canada](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/disc-brake-conversion-cost-canada/): CAD ranges for converting a classic from drums to discs — front versus four-wheel, why the master cylinder matters, and what 2026 traffic actually demands.
- [Overdrive in a Period Car: Highway RPM on the Yellowhead, and What the Swap Costs](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/overdrive-transmission-swap-classic/): Why a three-speed screams at 110 km/h on the Yellowhead, what an overdrive auto or five-speed actually costs in CAD, and how the swap fits a period car.
- [Points vs Electronic Ignition in Minus-Thirty Alberta: Why Wet Mornings Kill Starts](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/electronic-ignition-conversion-classics/): Why points drown on a wet Alberta morning, what an electronic conversion actually changes at minus thirty, and typical CAD ranges for the upgrade.
- [What E10 Ethanol Does to Classic Carbs, Fuel Lines, and Winter Storage](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/ethanol-fuel-classic-cars-canada/): How E10 absorbs water, attacks period rubber, and gums a carb over an Alberta winter — and the storage and fuel-system habits that actually hold.
- [Why a New Restomod Wiring Harness Stops Fires — and What It Costs in CAD](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/restomod-wiring-harness/): Why cloth and cracked PVC start classic-car fires, what a restomod harness actually includes, and typical CAD ranges — this is not a stereo job.
- [Classic Interior Restoration Cost in Canada: Seats, Headliner, Carpets](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-interior-restoration-cost-canada/): Typical CAD ranges for seats, headliner, and carpets on a classic in Alberta — what a driver interior costs, what show work costs, and where the hours hide.
- [Restore, Restomod, or Sell? Decide Before Rust Eats the Equity](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/restore-or-sell-classic-car/): An honest fork for a rusting classic: when restoration math works, when a restomod is the driveable path, and when selling now protects the equity.
- [Alberta Road Salt, Calcium Chloride, and What Actually Stops Rust](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/alberta-road-salt-rust-prevention/): What calcium chloride does to a classic underbody in Alberta, why a heated garage can make it worse, and the oil-film habits that actually work here.
